app_name: Mausam - India Meteorological Department & Ministry of Earth Sciences Weather Intelligence
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) combined with clean modern Indian governmental intelligence UI

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

components: Navbar with IMD emblem, location picker, persona quick switcher, notification center, dark mode toggle
Onboarding modal with persona selection & skip option
Hero Weather Card with live meteorological stats (AQI, UV, Humidity, Wind, Pressure, Sunrise/Sunset)
Persona-Specific Dynamic Intelligence Modules (Outdoor Fitness, Health, Beach/Surfer, Traveler, Parent/Family, Agriculture, Commuter, Event Planner)
Hourly Forecast 24-hour ticker with probability of precipitation
7-Day Extended Forecast with meteorological weather icons and temperature bars
Interactive Weather Radar & Map simulation with layer toggles (Precipitation, Wind Stream, Satellite, Temperature, Severe Alerts)
Alert Center with severity badge filters (Orange/Red/Yellow IMD warnings)
Saved Locations Manager with quick switching and weather comparisons
Dashboard Customization drawer/modal to reorder or toggle modules
Notification Center for severe weather and persona advisories
universal_guidelines: Every interactive element must include data-testid attributes
Start light theme with dark mode toggle
Ensure smooth animated transitions when switching personas
